base_member_text: [L2362-L2374] (HIGH/boundary-condition typo) The MPI left-boundary clause repeats Wm(1,:)=Wm(2,:) instead of setting Wm(:,1), so the left y boundary is not populated as the surrounding top/bottom/left/right pattern indicates.
audit_member_text: [L2362-L2374] (HIGH/MPI boundary indexing) The xmpi_isleft branch assigns Wm(1,:) instead of Wm(:,1), overwriting the top x row and leaving the left y boundary unset.

adversarial.rationale: The MPI physical-left branch copies a row instead of the left column, duplicating the top-boundary operation. The subsequent halo exchange has no neighbor at that physical boundary and therefore cannot supply the omitted column.

base_member_text: [L254-L372] (MED/lifecycle/allocation) nonh_init allocates module work arrays unconditionally, so a second initialization or a grid-size change without an intervening teardown can fail or retain an incompatible module lifecycle.
audit_member_text: [L290-L356] (MED/reinitialization/configuration lifecycle) nonh_init allocates module arrays unconditionally and never supports cleanup, resizing, or changing nonhq3d mode during a later model lifecycle.

adversarial.rationale: The public nonhydrostatic initializer unconditionally allocates persistent module arrays. No matching deallocation or allocation-state guard is supplied by the library lifecycle, so repeating initialization in the same process can allocate already allocated objects.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex independent skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L3453-L3465] (LOW/iteration termination) disper iterates solely on an error tolerance with no iteration cap or invalid-input guard, leaving termination dependent on unstated positive finite inputs.
audit_member_text: [L3311-L3319,L3420-L3465] (MED/unbounded/singular dispersion solve) wcoef initialization does not validate Topt, and disper has singular arithmetic for zero frequency/depth plus an iteration with no maximum-count or stagnation guard.

adversarial.rationale: The initializer floors depth with eps, so a normal dry cell is not a zero-depth counterexample. Non-strict Topt validation still permits invalid frequency input, and the dispersion iteration has no iteration/stagnation limit; the surviving issue is robustness outside the ordinary finite positive input regime.

adversarial.rationale: nhlay=1 is explicitly accepted by params.F90:900 and becomes wcoef in the reduced two-layer model. Expressions dividing by 1-wcoef are still evaluated for active wet nonhydrostatic cells, so wetting/breaking guards do not exclude the degenerate layer split.

[L556-L558,L1138-L1157,L1176-L1187,L1254-L1258] (MED/depth denominator contract) Several one-layer pressure, advection, viscosity, and explicit-pressure terms divide by hh based on nonhZ rather than an explicit positive-depth check, relying on the mask contract to guarantee a safe depth.

[L1172-L1177] (HIGH/directional coefficient mismatch) The y-direction vertical-viscosity flux uses s%hu at lines 1174-1175 even though it is evaluated across V faces, unlike the expected y-face depth s%hv.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: Both y-direction vertical-viscosity fluxes multiply by hu while differencing Wm along j and using ddyv. The wetv factors on the resulting divergence do not substitute the missing V-face depth hv on wet, directionally varying bathymetry.

evidence_span.quote:
dwdx1 = .5d0*(s%nuh(i-1,j  )+s%nuh(i,j  ))*s%hu(i-1,j  )*(Wm_old(i  ,j  )-Wm_old(i-1,j  ))*ddxu(i-1)
               dwdx2 = .5d0*(s%nuh(i+1,j  )+s%nuh(i,j  ))*s%hu(i  ,j  )*(Wm_old(i+1,j  )-Wm_old(i  ,j  ))*ddxu(i)
               dwdy1 = s%nuh(i  ,j-1)*s%hu(i  ,j-1)*(Wm_old(i  ,j  )-Wm_old(i  ,j-1))*ddyv(j-1)
               dwdy2 = s%nuh(i  ,j  )*s%hu(i  ,j  )*(Wm_old(i  ,j+1)-Wm_old(i  ,j  ))*ddyv(j)
               Wm(i,j) = Wm(i,j)   + (1.0_rKind/s%hh(i,j))*par%dt*(dwdx2-dwdx1)*ddxz(i)*real(s%wetu(i,j)*s%wetu(i-1,j),rKind) &
               + (1.0_rKind/s%hh(i,j))*par%dt*(dwdy2-dwdy1)*ddyz(j)*real(s%wetv(i,j)*s%wetv(i,j-1),rKind)

adversarial.rationale: The V viscosity contribution uses hu at the cited locations even though the corresponding directional depth is hv. The wetv mask establishes wetness, not equality of those independently calculated upwind depths, and viscosity can be nonzero on that path.

audit_member_text: [L3369-L3401] (MED/MPI halo initialization) On non-bottom MPI ranks zbu(nx+1,:) and zsu(nx+1,:) are not assigned or exchanged by zuzv, although nonh mask construction iterates through nx+1 and reads zbu there.
dispositions.rationale: span-refuted: nonh_init explicitly initializes zbu and zsu to zero at L294-L296, so their terminal row is not undefined. Although the halo mask loop reads zbu(nx+1,:), active U coefficients and pressure/mask stencils use indices no greater than nx (with imax_zs reduced on internal MPI boundaries in spaceparams.F90), so that unused terminal U-mask entry does not establish an MPI halo defect.
